name: Cal.com
summary: Manage Cal.com bookings, event types, and availability via Composio OAuth2.
description: Schedule, cancel, reschedule bookings, view event types, and check availability on Cal.com through your Composio OAuth2 connection.

preferences.name: COMPOSIO_API_KEY
preferences.title: Composio API key
preferences.description: Settings -> API Keys in your Composio dashboard (platform.composio.dev). Your Cal.com account must be connected there (toolkit: Cal).

preferences.name: CALCOM_CONNECTED_ACCOUNT_ID
preferences.title: Connected Account ID
preferences.description: Optional Cal.com connected account ID in Composio. Leave blank to auto-detect.

preferences.name: COMPOSIO_BASE_URL
preferences.title: Composio API Base URL
preferences.description: Optional. Leave blank for https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3.1 (old v1/v2 URLs are upgraded automatically).

preferences.name: COMPOSIO_USER_ID
preferences.title: Composio User ID
preferences.description: Optional. The user ID your Cal.com account was connected under in Composio (Connected Accounts → User ID). Leave blank to auto-detect.

tools.name: get_bookings
tools.title: Get bookings
tools.description: Retrieve upcoming scheduled Cal.com bookings and meetings for the authenticated user. Use when the user asks what meetings, calls, or appointments are scheduled; for my next meeting pass limit 1. Each booking's id is its Cal.com UID, used by cancel_booking and reschedule_booking.

limit.description: Number of bookings to retrieve (default: 10, max 10).

tools.name: create_booking
tools.title: Create booking
tools.description: Schedule a new meeting on Cal.com for an attendee (name, email) at a start time. Use when the user requests to schedule or book a meeting. Cal.com names the booking after its event type; the title is added to the booking notes. Without eventTypeId, the event type whose length matches duration is used.

title.description: Meeting title or topic (added to the booking notes).

start.description: Start time as ISO 8601 with timezone (e.g. 2026-11-12T15:30:00-06:00).

duration.description: Duration in minutes, used to pick the event type (default: 30).

eventTypeId.description: Optional Cal.com event type ID or slug (from get_event_types).

root.html: New booking

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.title: Cancel booking
tools.description: Cancel an existing Cal.com booking by its UID (the id from get_bookings) with an optional reason. Use when the user requests to cancel or remove a meeting; call get_bookings first if you don't have the UID.

bookingId.description: Booking UID to cancel (the id returned by get_bookings).

title.description: Exact value from get_bookings; verified against the booking before execution.

startTime.description: Exact value from get_bookings; verified against the booking before execution.

root.html:

tools.name: reschedule_booking
tools.title: Reschedule booking
tools.description: Move an existing Cal.com booking (by UID, the id from get_bookings) to a new start time. Use when the user asks to reschedule, move, or postpone an appointment. Cal.com issues a new UID for the moved booking.

bookingId.description: Booking UID to reschedule (the id returned by get_bookings).

newStartTime.description: New start time as ISO 8601 with timezone (e.g. 2026-11-12T15:30:00-06:00).

title.description: Exact value from get_bookings; verified against the booking before execution.

currentStartTime.description: Exact value from get_bookings; verified against the booking before execution.

root.html:
Reschedule
This booking
Was its current time

tools.name: get_event_types
tools.title: Get event types
tools.description: Fetch configured Cal.com event types showing durations and booking link slugs. Use when the user asks what booking links or event types are set up.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.title: Get availability
tools.description: Check open Cal.com time slots for an event type between two dates. Use when the user asks what times they are free or available for meetings. Without eventTypeId, the default 30-minute (or first) event type is used.

eventTypeId.description: Optional event type ID or slug (from get_event_types).

dateFrom.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: today).

dateTo.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: dateFrom).

username.description: Optional Cal.com username whose event types to look up.

tools.name: create_event_type
tools.title: Create event type
tools.description: Create a new Cal.com booking link and event type with a title, slug, and duration. Use when the user asks to create or set up a new booking link.

description.description: Optional description for this booking link.

root.html: New booking link
